courier-relay/protocol-1: Courier Relay protocol 1 provider contract, applicable to receipt analysis under explicit protocol "1". Source: vendor/protocol-1.md, adopted by issue trial-qw6. Delivery identity is the pair (account_id, delivery_id); the same delivery_id in another account is a separate delivery. This scope follows the provider delivery-ID allocation guarantee; account attribution alone does not change that guarantee. Exactly one receipt is accepted per identity: earliest occurred_at UTC instant, then smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order for equal instants. Compare offsets as UTC, including date-boundary crossings. All other receipts for that identity are duplicates. Accepted receipts retain every original field, timestamp spelling, and payload, and are presented in original input order. Source trial-qw6 also establishes protocol 1 as initially current: omitted protocol selects current; explicitly supported versions remain supported after current changes. Requests are independent complete receipt sets with no persistence. The count command returns exactly protocol (string "1"), accepted_count (integer unique identity count), and duplicate_count (integer total receipts minus accepted count); empty sets yield zero counts. trial-qw6 requests contain at most one account, but the provider identity guarantee includes account_id. Verification for trial-qw6: both supplied public count cases and four unit tests passed, covering ping, unknown command, empty default protocol, and duplicate delivery counts with explicit/default protocol. Receipt winner selection and presentation are retained provider requirements, not behavior exercised by count tests.
